text: {"purpose":"COSGN00C presents a sign‑on screen for the Card Demo application. It validates the entered user ID and password against a security file and, based on the user type, transfers control to either the admin or menu program.","inputs":["COMMAREA","USER-ID","USER-PWD"],"outputs":["COMMAREA","SCREEN"],"side_effects":["CALLS COADM01C or COMEN01C","MODIFIES COMMAREA"],"role":"online","error_handling":"SETS ERR-FLG, displays user‑friendly error messages, and returns to the caller with appropriate CICS response codes","evidence":[{"line_start":80,"line_end":96,"claim":"Main entry logic determines whether to display the sign‑on screen or process a key press based on EIBCALEN and EIBAID."},{"line_start":85,"line_end":95,"claim":"Handles ENTER, PF3, and invalid keys, invoking SEND‑SIGNON‑SCREEN or SEND‑PLAIN‑TEXT as appropriate."},{"line_start":108,"line_end":130,"claim":"Receives the map, checks for missing user ID or password, sets error flag, and sends the sign‑on screen if needed."},{"line_start":132,"line_end":136,"claim":"Moves the entered user ID and password into working storage and the common area."},{"line_start":138,"line_end":140,"claim":"If no error, performs READ‑USER‑SEC‑FILE to validate credentials."},{"line_start":145,"line_end":157,"claim":"Populates header info and sends the sign‑on screen to the user."},{"line_start":162,"line_end":169,"claim":"Sends a plain text thank‑you message when PF3 is pressed."},{"line_start":171,"line_end":172,"claim":"Returns control to the caller after sending text."},{"line_start":179,"line_end":196,"claim":"POPULATE‑HEADER‑INFO loads date, time, and application identifiers into the map."},{"line_start":198,"line_end":204,"claim":"Assigns application and system IDs for use in the map."},{"line_start":209,"line_end":257,"claim":"READ‑USER‑SEC‑FILE validates the user, sets error messages, and calls COADM01C or COMEN01C based on user type."},{"line_start":98,"line_end":102,"claim":"Executes CICS RETURN to send the updated COMMAREA back to the caller."}]}
